title: Finite-type ambient geometry and a common geometric-fibre dimension bound
statement: Let $p:T\to Y$ be a morphism of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] between schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Assume that $Y$ has a finite affine cover by spectra of Noetherian rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and finite topological Krull dimension [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Then $T$ also has such a finite Noetherian affine cover and finite topological Krull dimension. There exists $e\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ such that for every algebraically closed field $\Omega$ and every morphism $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to Y$, the fibre $T\times_Y\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-affine-spectrum] has topological Krull dimension at most $e$. Empty schemes and fibres have dimension $-\infty$ and are allowed. If an integer $N$ is a unit in every local ring of $Y$, it is a unit in every local ring of $T$.

proof.text: The finite Noetherian affine cover of Y makes Y Noetherian, hence compact and locally Noetherian. A locally finite-type morphism over Y has locally Noetherian source, and quasi-compactness of p makes T compact. Choose a finite subcover of its affine opens; their section rings are Noetherian. This is the first conclusion. The Lean proof uses isNoetherian_iff_of_finite_iSup_eq_top, LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian and IsLocallyNoetherian.component_noetherian, implementing the finite affine cover argument of the original plan.

proof.text: Fix a natural bound D on dim Y. For each x in T choose affine neighbourhoods V of p(x) and U of x with U contained in p^{-1}(V), and restrict p to U -> V. The algebra Gamma(U) is finite type over the Noetherian ring Gamma(V), hence a quotient of Gamma(V)[X_1,...,X_n]. The affine spectrum comparison and open-subspace monotonicity give dim Gamma(V) <= D. Pullback of prime chains along the quotient map gives dim Gamma(U) <= dim Gamma(V)[X_1,...,X_n] = dim Gamma(V)+n <= D+n. Thus U has a natural dimension bound. Compactness of T chooses finitely many such U. Take the maximum of their bounds, zero for the empty family, and apply the sober T0 open-cover dimension bound. This proves a natural bound d on dim T. The Lean private helpers affine_dimension_bound and finiteType_source_dimension_bound implement this argument in full.

proof.text: Use the already proved source theorem AlgebraicGeometry.topologicalKrullDim_pullback_le in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.FieldBaseChangeDimension. For every field-valued point h it gives dim(T times_Y Spec Omega) <= dim T, so the natural number d from the preceding step also bounds every geometric fibre. Its proof factors h through the residue field kappa(y); pullback associativity identifies the pullback with the field extension of p.fiber y. The closed source realization topologicalKrullDim_pullback_eq_of_field of [lem-pc-dim-base-change] preserves its dimension, and the fibre homeomorphism with the subspace p^{-1}({y}) gives dimension at most dim T. This route uses no algebraic-closedness assumption and covers empty fibres.

proof.text: For each t in T, the stalk map p.stalkMap t is a unital ring homomorphism from O_{Y,p(t)} to O_{T,t}. Apply IsUnit.map to the inverse of the image of N; preservation of integer casts identifies the result with N in the target stalk. If T is empty this conclusion is vacuous.
